images.description: The Hoàng Liên Sơn mountain range of Vietnam. The pic was taken in winter (February). It is very cold and cloudy at this time of the year (-2C with my pic). However the weather in September is hotter and makes the sky pure enough to look around. There are several ways to climb the top with different levels of difficulty and dangers. If you do climbing in cold season (From Nov to Mar) the voyage will surely be more dangerous and take much more time. One of the worst dangers is that you can go astray in the forest or broke yourself with sharp, high cliffs. However it's much easier in dry season (Sept. recommended).
